section1.title: 1. Controller
section1.intro: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
section1.contactQuestion: For questions about this privacy policy or your rights under the AVG (Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming), contact our DPO at the email above.

section2.title: 2. Personal Data We Process
section2.intro: We process the following categories of personal data:

company.examples: KvK number, company name, billing info

usage.examples: Page views, feature usage, search history

section3.title: 3. Special Category Data
section3.p1: We process work authorization status (EU citizen, work permit holder, etc.) which may reveal immigration status and, by extension, national origin. This constitutes special category data under AVG Article 9.
section3.p2: We only process this data with your explicit consent. You may withdraw this consent at any time through your privacy settings. If consent is withdrawn, your work authorization status will not be shown to employers, though a simple yes/no flag (hasWorkAuthorization) may still be displayed.
section3.p3: We strongly advise against including other special category data (nationality, gender, health information, union membership) in your profile. Our free-text fields are not designed for this type of data, and we are not authorized to process it.

section4.title: 4. Legal Bases for Processing
section4.intro: We process your personal data on the following legal bases:
section4.consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — Analytics, marketing communications, work authorization processing, cookie usage
section4.contract: Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b)) — Providing the platform, matching workers with employers, processing offers, messaging
section4.obligation: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) — KvK verification, tax record retention (7 years), fraud prevention
section4.interest: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — Security, platform improvement, audit logging, anonymized analytics

section5.title: 5. Data Sharing & Recipients
section5.intro: We share your personal data with the following categories of recipients:
section5.employers: Employers/Workers — Anonymized profile data until offer acceptance, then identity data as agreed
section5.aws: Amazon Web Services (AWS) — Cloud infrastructure, file storage (S3), email (SES)
section5.dpaNote: We have Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) with all processors. We do not sell your personal data.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.intro: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary:
section6.kvk: KvK verification data — 7 years after account closure

section7.title: 7. Your Rights Under the AVG
section7.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
section7.accessBody: You can request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
section7.rectificationBody: You can correct inaccurate personal data through your profile settings or by contacting us.
section7.erasureBody: You can request deletion of your personal data. Some data must be retained by law.
section7.restrictionBody: You can request that we restrict the processing of your data while a dispute is resolved.
section7.portabilityBody: You can receive your data in a machine-readable format (JSON/CSV).
section7.objectBody: You can object to processing based on legitimate interest or for direct marketing purposes.
section7.withdrawBody: Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.
section7.exerciseIntro: To exercise any of these rights, use your
section7.complaintIntro: If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the

section8.title: 8. Automated Decision-Making & Profiling
section8.p1: We use automated systems to match workers with employers based on skills, experience, and preferences. These are not decisions that produce legal effects or significantly affect you. Our matching algorithm does not use special category data (such as nationality or health data) as input factors.
section8.p2: Workers can always control their profile visibility and what information employers can see. Our anonymous profile system ensures that employers cannot identify you until you accept an offer.

section9.title: 9. International Data Transfers
section9.p1: Our primary infrastructure is hosted within the European Union (AWS EU regions — Ireland and Frankfurt). However, some of our processors operate outside the EU:

stripe.safeguard: SCCs + Stripe Data Processing Agreement; EU-US Data Privacy Framework

sentry.safeguard: SCCs + Sentry DPA; Data Processing Agreement

section9.sccNote: Where data is transferred to countries outside the EEA that do not have an adequacy decision, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, supplemented by Data Processing Agreements that include the mandatory Art. 28 GDPR provisions. You may request a copy of the relevant SCCs by contacting our DPO.

section10.title: 10. Security Measures
section10.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
section10.encryption: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)
section10.rbac: Role-based access control for admin access
section10.anonymized: Anonymized worker profiles until offer acceptance
section10.audits: Regular security audits and penetration testing
section10.breach: Breach notification within 72 hours to the Dutch DPA
section10.tfa: Two-factor authentication available for all accounts

section11.intro: For detailed information about the cookies we use, please see our

section12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
section12.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email and through a prominent notice on our website. We will always obtain your consent for any new processing that requires it.

dashboard.title: Privacy Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your personal data, consent preferences, and exercise your GDPR rights. Under the AVG (Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming), you have full control over your data.

rights.accessBody: Request confirmation and a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
rights.erasureBody: Request deletion of your personal data with a 30-day grace period.
rights.portabilityBody: Export your data in a machine-readable format for transfer.
rights.automatedBody: Object to decisions made solely by automated means and request human review.

overview.downloadBody: Get a copy of all your personal data
overview.restrictBody: Limit how your data is processed
overview.rightsBody: If you believe that the processing of your personal data infringes the AVG, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

access.title: Right of Access (Art. 15 AVG)
access.intro: Under Article 15 of the AVG, you have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether personal data concerning you is being processed, and access to that data along with information about the purposes, categories, recipients, retention periods, and your rights.
access.portabilityNote: This is different from Data Portability (Art. 20), which allows you to receive your data in a machine-readable format for transfer to another controller. Use this tab to submit a formal access request; use the “Data Portability” tab for data export.
access.receive1: Confirmation that your data is being processed
access.receive2: A complete copy of all personal data we hold about you
access.receive7: Information about your rights (rectification, erasure, restriction, objection)
access.receive8: Information about the source of the data (if not collected from you directly)
access.receive9: Information about automated decision-making, including profiling
access.responseTime: We will respond to your request within 30 days. In complex cases, this may be extended by a further 60 days, in which case we will inform you of the delay and the reasons.
access.submitSuccess: Your access request has been submitted. We will respond within 30 days as required by the AVG.
access.submitPending: You may already have a pending access request.
access.submitError: Unable to submit access request. Please try again later.

automated.title: Automated Decision-Making (Art. 22 AVG)
automated.intro: Under Article 22 of the AVG, you have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing — including profiling — that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects you. You can object to such decisions and request human review.
automated.example1: Automated rejection of job applications or offers
automated.example2: Algorithmic profile scoring that affects your visibility to employers
automated.example3: Automated fraud detection that restricts your account
automated.example4: Automated trust or risk scores that limit your access
automated.reasonLabel: Why do you believe this decision was made solely by automated means? *
automated.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the decision and why you believe it was made without human intervention...
automated.humanReviewLabel: I request human review of this decision (recommended)
automated.alertReasonRequired: Please describe why you believe this decision was automated.
automated.submitSuccess: Your objection to the automated decision has been submitted. {message}
automated.submitSuccessFallback: Processing of this type of decision has been paused pending human review.
automated.submitError: Unable to submit your objection. Please try again later.
automated.footer: When you submit this objection, your processing will be restricted until a human reviews the decision. You will be contacted within 30 days with the outcome of the review.

delete.title: Delete Your Account
delete.subtitle: Exercise your right to erasure under AVG Article 17. This will permanently delete your account and personal data after a 30-day grace period.
delete.restrictBody: Keep your account but limit how your data is used.
delete.hideBody: Make your profile invisible without deleting your account. Available in your profile settings.

consent.title: Consent Management
consent.subtitle: Manage your consent preferences for each type of data processing. Under the AVG (GDPR), you have the right to withdraw consent at any time.
consent.noteBody: Withdrawing consent for required processing (such as data processing for contract performance) may limit your ability to use certain features. Special category consent (work authorization) can be withdrawn at any time without affecting core functionality — your profile will simply not show your work authorization status to employers.

export.subtitle: Exercise your right to data portability under AVG Article 20. Download all personal data we hold about you in a machine-readable format.
export.footnote: Your export is provided in JSON format for maximum portability. Download links expire after 30 days. You can request a new export at any time.

restriction.subtitle: Restrict how we process your data — GDPR Article 18 (Right to Restriction of Processing).
restriction.warning: When processing is restricted, we will only store your data and not process it further, except where required by law. This may limit your ability to use the platform.
